name: checkmk
title: Checkmk
description: Search hosts and services in Checkmk, handle problems and get notified about new ones
author: mendyka

commands.name: monitor
commands.title: Problem Monitor
commands.subtitle: Checkmk
commands.description: Checks Checkmk in the background and sends a notification for new problems. Enable it via the command's background refresh setting.

preferences.name: checkEvery
preferences.title: Check Every
preferences.description: How often the monitor queries Checkmk

preferences.name: minSeverity
preferences.title: Minimum Severity
preferences.description: Which service states trigger a notification

preferences.name: includeHosts
preferences.title: Hosts
preferences.label: Notify when hosts go DOWN / UNREACHABLE

preferences.name: ignoreHandled
preferences.title: Handled Problems
preferences.label: Ignore acknowledged problems and downtimes
preferences.description: Skip problems that are acknowledged or in a scheduled downtime

preferences.name: notifyRecovery
preferences.title: Recoveries
preferences.label: Notify when problems recover
preferences.description: Send a notification when a problem is gone

preferences.name: hostFilter
preferences.title: Only Hosts Matching
preferences.description: Optional regular expression (case-insensitive) for host names

preferences.name: serviceFilter
preferences.title: Only Services Matching
preferences.description: Optional regular expression (case-insensitive) for service names

preferences.name: serviceExclude
preferences.title: Exclude Services Matching
preferences.description: Optional regular expression (case-insensitive) for services to ignore

preferences.name: siteUrl
preferences.title: Site URL
preferences.description: URL of your Checkmk site including the site name, e.g. https://monitoring.example.com/mysite

preferences.name: secret
preferences.title: Automation Secret / Password
preferences.description: Automation secret of the user (Setup → Users → Automation secret)

preferences.name: allowInsecure
preferences.title: TLS
preferences.label: Allow self-signed certificates
preferences.description: Skip TLS certificate validation (only for internal servers)
